catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antinoe: A 1913 entry on Antinoe — Antinoöpolis, the Egyptian city, now a titular see. Henri Leclercq tells its Christian past. Its bishops graced the old councils. The Nile guards its ruined quays. A see of the Thebaid. Its bishops signed the ancient creeds.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-arsinoe: A 1913 entry on Arsinoe — the Egyptian city, now a titular see. Thomas Shahan notes its Christian past. Its bishops graced the old councils. The Faiyum guards its ruined site. A see of the Nile's valley. Its bishops signed the ancient creeds.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-bartholomew-r: This 1913 reference piece on Bartholomew Roe — the Benedictine martyr. John Wainewright honors his death. He died for the old faith's sake. The entry preserves his modest fame. A monk of the English martyrs. His death honored the Benedictine habit. His feast joins the martyrs' roll.
